relations.description: Lower layer failure causes procedure abortion.
Lower layer failure causes AMF to enter 5GMM-IDLE mode.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain 5G-GUTI IE.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain TAI list IE.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain PEIPS assistance information IE.
Registration procedure includes sending REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message contains De-registration type IE.
REGISTRATION REJECT message causes procedure abortion.
